summary: The LCD stays blank because the code uses I2C address 0x3F, but the connected I2C backpack responds at 0x27.

causes.title: I2C device is at 0x27, code uses 0x3F
causes.why: The runtime trace found the I2C device at 0x27, but line 5 uses 0x3F: LiquidCrystal_I2C lcd(0x3F, 16, 2);
causes.check: Look at the backpack chip on your LCD module to verify its I2C address.
causes.fix: Change the address in the constructor to 0x27: LiquidCrystal_I2C lcd(0x27, 16, 2);

rule_findings.title: LCD I2C address mismatch (0x3F in code, 0x27 on the part)
rule_findings.evidence: The LCD only answers on its own address; the screen stays blank.
rule_findings.fix: Use 0x27 in the LiquidCrystal_I2C constructor, or run an I2C scanner.

rule_findings.title: I2C device is at 0x27, code uses 0x3F
rule_findings.evidence: The startup I2C scan found a device, but not at the address in the code.
rule_findings.fix: Change the address in the code to 0x27.
